rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Very steep narrow street with homes 5-11 m from the kerb.
reasons: Dwellings 5-6 m away along most of it

drivers.seclusion: Houses and pool right beside the kerb; dwellings 5-11 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane, trees and walls at the edge; no clear shoulder.
drivers.convention: Few cars parked; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the east side; shaded from the east.

best_section.where: East side of Duke Street, just north of the main road junction
